# The Account Hub Daily default still depends on the existing-account setup gate

Fresh full five-file pref/harness patch read. The landing enables mail.accounthub.enabled only inside NIGHTLY_BUILD and retains false in the non-Nightly branch. The needed historical openAccountSetup caller additionally requires !isInitialSetup and at least one existing account; therefore the default flip alone does not enable first-account onboarding or all release channels. Review initially accepted, then requested the missing #endif, followed by the actual completed guard/update and reacceptance. The full new entrypoint test covers menubar, appmenu, account-central and account-settings entrypoints by creating a pre-existing account. Tests skip when the pref is disabled; the menubar case additionally skips macOS. The shared helper now waits for the host, shadow dialog, open state, selected template and visibility, and callers await the resolved dialog. The lingering Promise<HTMLDialogElement> parameter annotations are already covered by the existing focused documentation proposal; this landing does not fix that semantic type error.

Scope: Account Hub rollout and entrypoint tests.
